description: This Java class 'MappingTimer' provides utility methods for creating and managing timers to measure different segments of mapping operations within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging framework. It supports inbound and outbound timing, as well as payload and protocol segmentation, with integrated logging and tracing.

classes.name: MappingTimer
classes.description: Utility class for creating and managing timers for measuring mapping operation segments, including inbound/outbound, payload, and protocol timing.

methods.name: inbound
methods.description: Creates a MappingTimer instance for inbound mapping measurement, tagged with 'inbound'.

methods.name: outbound
methods.description: Creates a MappingTimer instance for outbound mapping measurement, tagged with 'outbound'.

methods.name: overall
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a Runnable or Supplier for the entire mapping operation.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a Supplier within a 'payload' segment, tagged with the specified mapper.

methods.name: protocol
methods.description: Measures the execution time of a Supplier within a 'protocol' segment.

methods.name: timed
methods.description: Helper method to execute a Supplier with timing and success/failure tagging.

methods.name: timed
methods.description: Helper method to execute a Runnable with timing and success/failure tagging.

methods.name: startNewTimer
methods.description: Initializes a new expiring timer with connection details and handles expiration logging.
